newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tea Smallholder soars on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Tea Smallholder soars on retail buying.

text.p: Shares of Tea Smallholder Factories Ltd rose 9.68 percent or three rupees to 34 on Thursday on heavy retail buying, brokers said.
"Small retail investors are getting in to cheap shares in the plantation sector, which is expected to see good growth in 1997," said a local broker.
Good demand for Sri Lanka tea, mainly from the Commonwealth of Independent States, is expected to make 1997 another good year for plantation firms listed in Colombo.
Tea Smallholder Factories processes tea leaf bought from small cultivators.
